product_one_liner.value: Vectary is a browser-based collaborative design platform for creative and business teams to develop concepts with AI and create interactive 3D presentations and augmented-reality experiences.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes the platform, its AI-assisted ideation, interactive 3D, and AR experiences.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans and prices are listed, including Free, Starter, Team, and custom-priced Business plans.

named_customers.notes: These names appear in Vectary's success stories/case studies.

employee_band.notes: GetLatka reports 31 employees in October 2024; LinkedIn lists the broader 11–50 range. The reported estimate falls in the 21–50 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Redwood City, California, United States as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company profile lists 2014 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is mainly marketing, design, tutorials, workflow and product/feature content; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts on how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public help center has multiple product documentation sections, including Canvas, importing, design process, configurators, sharing/exporting, and an API.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Searches did not surface a Vectary careers page or job board, so current AI/ML openings could not be verified.

model_provider.notes: The public help center and Terms of Service were checked. The Terms refer generically to third-party AI providers and allow model selection where available, but name no specific provider or model.

compliance_certs.notes: Vectary explicitly says it is SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified and complies with GDPR. It also mentions CCPA, which is not among the requested options.

last_funding.notes: Funding sources identify a $4.6 million Series A/venture round announced January 25, 2023.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent round found was dated January 2023, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No Vectary careers page or live job board was found, so current SDR, BDR, or account executive hiring could not be verified.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest launch-type announcement located was Vectary Canvas, posted April 17, 2026, before the six-month window beginning May 9, 2026. The company's Canvas page describes that feature.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No sufficiently complete team page or dated executive join/departure announcement was found to verify a leadership change or its absence.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations page names monday as an integration. It does not specify that Vectary uses monday's CRM functionality.
